titulo: Sony Squeezes in Last-Minute PS5 Firmware Security Update Ahead of GTA 6 Release Date, Amid Fresh Hacker Claim
texto: Sony has released a new PS5 firmware security update just a day before the release of GTA 6, and hot on the heels of a new claim from a prominent hacker around the console.
